title: Connect Claude to Genie One with the Databricks Genie connector
body: The Databricks Genie connector connects Claude to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from Claude. A Claude admin connects it for the team, and each user connects by signing in with their Databricks account. See [Databricks Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Bot/Cursor](/aws/en/agents/mcp-tools/genie-mcp#genie-plugins).
